analysis.assetRisk: Reward dilution only - no principal theft. Attacker stakes real tokens and takes genuine risk.
analysis.attackPath: Valid - standard MEV sandwich attack pattern, no hypotheticals
analysis.conditions: Requires mempool monitoring capability - documented and achievable
analysis.impact: 30x efficiency gain for attacker, diluted rewards for legitimate stakers

upgradeConsideration.rejectionReason: Attacker captures rewards during their stake period, not stealing existing rewards. Disproportionate distribution efficiency is not asset theft per C4 High definition.

severityAudit.notes: Severity is accurate. The 30x efficiency gain is concerning but represents unfair distribution, not direct theft. Medium is the correct classification per C4 criteria.

analysis.assetRisk: Undistributed rewards become stuck - 51% loss demonstrated. Rewards, not principal.
analysis.attackPath: Requires sole staker status or coordination - external condition limits exploitability
analysis.conditions: Zero totalStaked state must occur (organic or coordinated)
analysis.impact: Permanent reward loss, no recovery mechanism exists

upgradeConsideration.rejectionReason: Lost funds are undistributed protocol rewards, not user deposits. Attack requires external conditions (zero-stake state). Self-griefing is economically irrational.

borderlineFlags: Permanent loss aspect could theoretically argue for High
If judges view protocol rewards as user-entitled funds, severity could shift
severityAudit.notes: Medium is correct. The permanent nature and 51% loss justify Medium severity, but reward-vs-principal distinction prevents High upgrade.

analysis.assetRisk: ~0.0001 tokens after 1000 operations - negligible absolute impact
analysis.attackPath: No attack - passive integer division behavior inherent to Solidity
analysis.conditions: Always occurs but impact is dust-level
analysis.impact: Dust accumulation - standard DeFi integer arithmetic limitation

severityAudit.disagreementReason: Precision loss of ~100 wei per operation is textbook dust accumulation, not a Medium severity vulnerability. This is inherent to integer division in all DeFi protocols. After 100,000 operations, total loss would be ~$0.01 for stablecoins. Protocol function and availability are not impacted.

notMediumBecause: Protocol function not impacted - staking and rewards work correctly
Protocol availability not impacted - no DoS vector
Value leak is negligible - ~0.01 tokens per 100K operations
Cannot be weaponized - no attacker benefits
Standard behavior - all DeFi protocols have similar dust accumulation
precedents: Uniswap V2/V3 swap dust - not considered vulnerability
Aave interest precision loss - not considered vulnerability
Compound rounding dust - not considered vulnerability

riskOfKeepingMedium: Potential judge rejection as not a vulnerability
severityAudit.notes: Strong recommendation to downgrade. Submitting dust accumulation as Medium risks credibility with judges.

conclusions.M-03: KEEP as Medium - correct classification (flagged for human review)
conclusions.M-04: DOWNGRADE to Low/QA - dust accumulation not Medium severity
